crossRefs.note: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills…
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil…
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having…
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

translations.web: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
translations.bsb: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
translations.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
translations.asv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first the inside of the cup and of the platter, that the outside thereof may become clean also.
